name: Match detail page shows the round or group label
description: When a visitor opens a match permalink, the page surfaces the round-or-group label identifying the stage of the fixture.

planSteps.description: Read the first match id from the response
Navigate to /match/<first-id> using the captured id
Verify the match detail page renders a stage label such as a group letter, R32, R16, QF, SF, F, or 3P
